But before we start the game, let's review the rules real quick: there are 10 players—3 Mafia and 7 Town members. Every night, the Mafia picks one player to kill, the Doctor picks one player to save, and the Sheriff picks one player to investigate and reveal if they're Mafia. Then there's the Vigilante, who has a gun with one shot; on any night, they can use their shot on someone they think is Mafia. Other players are Villagers who don't know anything. During the day, all players can vote to kill one person. The Town wins if they vote out all the Mafia; the Mafia wins if they kill enough Town members to get a majority. These are the assigned rules for the game.
